L4 drive units (Poclain MS05 + T04, RS120-2 chain 15T:45T, pressed hub, oil-bath case, disc/2 calipers) detailed on L-103.2 (×4; shop detail Loco Bot L-103). SS± HSS3x3x1/8, cab C1 813.9) + pony 1.25 t; plates removable, quantity set at weigh-in. Battery 2 × 24 V AGM 56 kg under the cab floor between the rails.
